newsitem.title: GERMANY: Thyssen, Preussag up on cooperation.
newsitem.headline: Thyssen, Preussag up on cooperation.

text.p: Shares in German engineering groups Preussag AG and Thyssen AG rose on Friday after news that the companies plan to cooperate on shipbuilding.
Preussag was up 11.60 marks or 2.2 percent at 539.10 marks at 1000 GMT while Thyssen was up 10.50 marks or 2.5 percent at 433 marks.
The shares outperfomed the broader share market, with the DAX index of 30 blue-chip shares up 1.23 percent at 4,041.19 at the same time.
Thyssen AG said on Friday initial talks on cooperation are planned for next week, with concrete negotiations due to start in autumn. But the company added that the results were open.
The spokesman said no firm decisions had been made over future structures, or which company might have leadership in an eventual merger.
The Hamburger Abendblatt daily reported on Friday that Thyssen Industrie chairman Eckhard Rohkamm had not ruled out a merger.
"One hopes that should lead to synergy benefits," one dealer said. "It may also lead to job cuts in the long term."
